scope: Build pure Gleam/OTP read-only restoration dashboard and bounded native observer; refresh at300seconds or completion event, track all current-goal tasks and capability evidence; no production mutation.

snapshot.reference: Current operator asks300s and completion-triggered refresh; task store canonical, existing dashboard is timestamped snapshot.

criticality.rationale: False freshness can hide missing operational evidence and mislead recovery decisions.

stpa.rationale: Feedback claims must distinguish an observed valid sample from absent telemetry.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36, band4: known false-positive freshness with material operational impact.

dependency.rationale: Reliable operator feedback supports subsequent service verification and release decisions.

impact.rationale: Cockpit health and freshness consumers affected; no claim all system telemetry is repaired.

fmea_modes.cause: Nonempty JSON stubs and literal booleans are classified as fresh live wiring.
fmea_modes.effect: Operator treats unavailable or stale telemetry as healthy and may take invalid recovery action.
fmea_modes.controls: Explicit runtime availability, typed unknown status, actual sample provenance/age where available, negative controls for fallback, invalid, missing and stale samples.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Publish operational health and freshness feedback

ucas.context: Missing telemetry is hidden rather than surfaced.
ucas.constraint: Require observed sample identity, availability and age for positive freshness; preserve unknown without evidence.

ucas.context: Unavailable stub response is reported fresh or healthy.
ucas.constraint: Require observed sample identity, availability and age for positive freshness; preserve unknown without evidence.

ucas.context: Old or future-dated sample is called current.
ucas.constraint: Require observed sample identity, availability and age for positive freshness; preserve unknown without evidence.

ucas.context: Cached success remains green after its evidence expires.
ucas.constraint: Require observed sample identity, availability and age for positive freshness; preserve unknown without evidence.

decision.summary: Build pure Gleam/OTP read-only restoration dashboard and bounded native observer; refresh at300seconds or completion event, track all current-goal tasks and capability evidence; no production mutation.
alternatives: Typed honest unavailable/unknown projection with actual evidence where present: selected.
Keep string-length success or make every route falsely green: rejected.
counterevidence: Core services and Zenoh router are running, so missing native telemetry is not proof all underlying services are down.
Forecast endpoint already reports UNKNOWN; avoid replacing it with synthetic confidence.
assumptions: Known service APIs may lack observation timestamps; those stay UNKNOWN rather than fabricate freshness.
decision.forecast: Read-only dashboard can provide current evidence without expanding effect authority.
decision.falsifier: Any stale value presented current, truncated or duplicate task count, unsupported PASS, secret exposure, or global admission inferred from task counts.
acceptance: Canonical Sa-plan task/job/workflow read-only observations, no private args/results or credentials exposed.
All current goal plans plus audit/repair/dashboard work enumerated, expired executing distinguished, each task maps to goal capability and acceptance outcome.
Observe health/source/evidence parameters max300seconds old and refresh task completion within bounded polling/event delay; show last observed time, stale errors and next refresh.
Real browser table/filter/status and auto-refresh tests with fixture clock plus actual runtime changes.
Full FQDN links, 18checkpoints, ASIS/TOBE/risk/criticality/mitigation, no fabricated global completion score.
Immutable candidate exact source private build and invocation receipts; dev-only runtime no production cutover.
decision.rollback: Keep deployed capsule/main unchanged; preserve own isolated candidate on failure.
decision.reviewer: Codex independent source and behavioral review after AGY implementation.
decision.budget: One bounded AGY implementation and independent reviewer; local realized tools, no new packages or production effects.
residuals: Automatic refresh is not operational until observed and independently verified.
Full restoration requires separate candidate release and feature acceptance.
